description: This file defines the Session controller for the Coocook web application, handling user login, logout, and session management functionalities.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Session
classes.description: Controller class managing user session actions such as login and logout.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests for displaying the login page, pre-filling username if available.

methods.name: post_login
methods.description: Processes POST request for user login, authenticates user, sets session and cookies, or redirects on failure.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles POST request to log out the user, clearing session and providing feedback.
